concepts.name: The seer in the Spirit
concepts.why: Scholar / Reformed / Pentecostal: the name is Ezekiel's words (3:12, 11:24, 43:5 'the Spirit lifted me up') but Revelation 1:10 ('I was in the Spirit') and 4:2 ('At once I was in the Spirit') do not say anyone was lifted; only Rev 17:3 and 21:10 ('carried me away') and Ezekiel 8:3 do. A name that one group of passages says and others do not. Use the plain label (all notes already exact), or keep the name and drop Revelation 1:10 and 4:2.

concepts.name: The white, red, black and pale green horses
concepts.why: Scholar / biblical-theological: the site's own standard (it renamed 'bow in the cloud' because the Berean differs) is the Berean's words. Revelation 6:8 in the Berean is 'a pale green horse', and the Revelation 6:8 note already quotes 'pale green'; the name says 'pale'.

Scholar / Jewish reader of the Hebrew Bible: Joel 3:2 gathers the nations to the Valley of Jehoshaphat 'to enter into judgment'; it does not say battle, so under 'Assembled for battle' it reads the passage as a battle. The other passages (Zechariah 14:2, Rev 16:14, 19:19, 20:8) say battle or war; Psalm 2:2 and Ezekiel 38 are set against the LORD / Gog.

note_fixes: Revelation 20:4–6: add this passage with the note 'And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years' reduced to the exact words of 20:5 'The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.' so that Daniel 12:2, Isaiah 26:19 and John 5:28–29 stand beside every Revelation statement of the dead coming to life, not only 20:13
concepts.why: Baptist / dispensational and historic-premillennial readers (and Reformed amillennial in the other direction): as built, the classic proof texts of the resurrection debate (Daniel 12:2, John 5:28–29) are set only beside Revelation 20:13, the resurrection after the thousand years, while the 'first resurrection' (20:5–6) sits apart in another concept. That sorts them into one reading of the order of the last things. Setting them beside both 20:5–6 and 20:13 takes no side.
